positions.title: Technology Consultant Intern
positions.description: Worked in a team of four to create an android application that used Google Fit's API and wearable technology for a fortune 500 health care company. I also worked on the refactoring of a mobile application for the client and concluded the internship with a business proposal to help boost revenue and reduce costs based on the mobile application my team created.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Tutor students in JAVA Programming
Hold office hours to help students understand concepts that arise in programming assignments
Lead class discussions with other tutors

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked in a team of 3 in the Auto Physical Damage Department as a software developer
Designed the logging system used for the company with the use of log4net, PostSharp and Application Insights
Refactored code for the company API 
Worked in an Agile team setting with daily stand up meetings and bi-weekly demos and sprint planning 
Participated in company Hackathon and created an Android mobile app where company amenities could be easily accessed 
Tested features using Karma for unit tests and Protractor for end to end testing

projects.title: California Space Grant Consortium Intern
projects.description: I worked on the Arduino team programming in Arduino C. A balloon is sent up to near space with a payload box containing experiments that are controlled by the arduino. We tested voltage and current from solar panels in order to see the change that occurred with the rising temperature as the payload neared the sun.

organizations.name: CODE2040
organizations.description: CODE2040 is a nonprofit organization that creates pathways to educational, professional, and entrepreneurial success in technology for underrepresented minorities with a specific focus on Blacks and Latino/as.
